name: GetTextureRegisterBits
evidence: returns the entry's word at 0x18 ORed with the selected cell's word at 0x10; func_001B29E0 and func_001ADD28 send it as GS register 6 (TEX0_1)

name: SendTextureRegisters
evidence: builds register words from GetTextureRegisterBits and the table's flags and sends them through func_00161708 as registers 6/7, 0x14/0x15 and 9 (TEX0, TEX1, TEX2 range)

name: ReadImageRecordB
evidence: reads a 12-byte image record from the stream, rebases its word at 8 by D_00275718 and stores its size in quadwords at +0xC; LoadImageRecordsB calls it for each record

name: LoadImageRecordsB
evidence: reads the count of the second image records, allocates g_imageRecordsB (0x18 bytes each) and reads each with ReadImageRecordB, then keeps in g_imageSlotsB the larger of those with bit 0x10000000 and the rest

name: ReadImageRecordA
evidence: reads a 0x14-byte image record from the stream, keeps its size in quadwords at +0x14 and rebases its offset at +0x10 by D_00275718; LoadImageRecordsA calls it for each record

name: LoadImageRecordsA
evidence: reads the count of the first image records, allocates g_imageRecordsA (0x20 bytes each) and reads each with ReadImageRecordA, then keeps in g_imageSlotsA the larger of those with bit 0x10000000 and the rest

name: LoadFonts
evidence: reads a u16 count, allocates that many font records, loads each with LoadFont, tags it with bit i, then sets the default font to font 0

name: ReadTextureTable
evidence: reads a record's 0x14-byte texture table: six bytes, then entryCount indexes into g_imageRecordsA and cellCount indexes into g_imageRecordsB (0xFFFF for none), each table on front memory

name: LoadScreenResources
evidence: reads image records A and B, animation records with their per-kind packet buffers and cursor animators, loads fonts, binds the animators, places masked images, uploads the fonts and initialises the screen elements

name: SendResidentImages
evidence: sends the images of mask 0x10000000 to the GIF from a bump allocator at 0x1E00 and forgets the active image mask (g_activeImageMask = 0)

name: SwitchActiveImageMask
evidence: flushes cursors and, if the mask differs from the current one (D_00274518), resets the bump allocator, places the mask's images, rebuilds their packets, flushes the mesh queue and updates matching listed objects

name: BuildAnimRecordGifPackets
evidence: for every animation record matching the mask, builds per-kind GIF packets of TEST/ALPHA/texture register writes into the record's packet buffers

name: ResetScreenResources
evidence: clears every count and table LoadScreenResources fills (image records, fonts, anim records, cursor animators, the pending cursors and the per-mask uploads)

name: ConvertRgbToHsv
evidence: takes the largest and smallest of three colour components (max.s, min.s) and computes hue, saturation and value from them in place

name: ConvertHsvToRgb
evidence: splits the hue into six sectors (a jump table) and computes three colour components from hue, saturation and value in place

name: ConvertHsv255ToRgb255
evidence: scales the second and third components of a 0..255 colour by 1/255, runs ConvertHsvToRgb and scales the result by 255

name: ConvertRgb255ToHsv255
evidence: scales a 0..255 colour by 1/255, runs ConvertRgbToHsv and scales saturation and value back by 255

name: FindAnimRecord
evidence: scans the D_002744F8 records of D_002744FC for one whose key matches, null for -1 or no match

name: SetCursorFrame
evidence: clamps the frame to [0, frameCount-1], stores it in the cursor and links the cursor into the list to flush when it changed

name: SetCursorCoords
evidence: stores a coordinate pair in the cursor if it changed and links the cursor into the list to flush

name: FlushCursors
evidence: walks the list D_0027451C writing each link's target value from the cursor's frame, then clears the list

name: StepAnimators
evidence: for each of the D_0027453C animators in D_00274540 calls slot 2 with dt when ClaimAnimatorStep returns 1

name: GetAnimatorSize
evidence: maps the type 1 to 8 to the byte size of its variant, used as the allocation size by ReadAnimator

name: GetAnimatorMethods
evidence: maps the type 1 to 8 to the address of its method table, stored by ReadAnimator

name: ReadAnimator
evidence: reads a type from the stream, allocates func_001B4920(type) bytes, stores the methods of func_001B4980(type) and the type, and calls slot 0 with a 0x1C-byte block

name: LoadAnimatorBase
evidence: copies the stream block's record key into the animator and sets bit 0 (and bit 2 if the block's flag is set) of its cursor flags; every variant's slot 0 starts with it

name: BindAnimatorRecord
evidence: stores FindAnimRecord(recordKey) in the cursor's record when it is still null; slot 1 of four tables and called by the other binders

name: ClaimAnimatorStep
evidence: returns 1 and stores D_0026185C into the stamp when the stamp differs, else 0; StepAnimators calls it before slot 2

name: GetAnimatorZeroProgress
evidence: returns 0.0f; slot 3 of the tables of types 3, 4, 8 and 5

name: FindAnimatorCursor
evidence: returns the animator's cursor when the record's key equals its recordKey, else 0; slot 5 of seven tables

name: LoadFrameRunAnimator
evidence: slot 0 of D_0021E358: LoadAnimatorBase then copies the duration and wait ranges and the start frame from the block

name: BindFrameRunAnimator
evidence: slot 1 of D_0021E358: binds the record then draws a duration and a wait and sets rate = frameCount / duration

name: StepFrameRunAnimator
evidence: slot 2 of D_0021E358: waits, then advances pos by rate*dt, wraps it at frameCount and sets the cursor's frame

name: GetFrameRunProgress
evidence: slot 3 of D_0021E358: returns the fraction of the run plus wait that pos has covered

name: LoadFramePingPongAnimator
evidence: slot 0 of D_0021E378: LoadAnimatorBase then copies the duration and wait ranges and the start frame from the block

name: BindFramePingPongAnimator
evidence: slot 1 of D_0021E378: binds the record then sets rate = 2*frameCount / duration

name: StepFramePingPongAnimator
evidence: slot 2 of D_0021E378: advances pos, negates rate at frameCount and re-draws at zero, so the frame goes forwards then back

name: GetFramePingPongProgress
evidence: slot 3 of D_0021E378: returns the fraction of the 2*frameCount cycle plus wait that pos has covered

name: LoadRandomJumpAnimator
evidence: slot 0 of D_0021E398: LoadAnimatorBase then copies the wait range from the block

name: StepRandomJumpAnimator
evidence: slot 2 of D_0021E398: after the wait, moves the frame by a random 1 to frameCount-1 modulo frameCount and draws a new wait

name: LoadAngleFrameAnimator
evidence: slot 0 of D_0021E3B8: stores the phase and sector = 2 pi / count from the block

name: BindAngleFrameAnimator
evidence: slot 1 of D_0021E3B8: binds the record then sets step = sector / frameCount

name: FollowObjectAngle
evidence: slot 4 of D_0021E3B8: when the other object's method table is D_00166690, takes the angle of its vector, subtracts phase, wraps by sector and sets the cursor's frame to angle / step

name: LoadScrollAnimator
evidence: slot 0 of D_0021E3D8: reads the scroll velocities and wrap sizes from the block and sets cursor flag bit 1 (coordinates)

name: StepScrollAnimator
evidence: slot 2 of D_0021E3D8: adds velocity*scale*dt to the cursor's coordinates, wraps them and sets them

name: GetScrollProgress
evidence: slot 3 of D_0021E3D8: returns half the u coordinate over wrapU plus half the v coordinate over wrapV (0.5 for an axis with no velocity), a value in [0, 1]

name: SetScrollScale
evidence: sets mulU and mulV of the scroll animator

name: LoadCircleAnimator
evidence: slot 0 of D_0021E3F8: reads omega, radius and the center from the block and sets cursor flag bit 1 (coordinates)

name: StepCircleAnimator
evidence: slot 2 of D_0021E3F8: sets the coordinates to center + radius*(cos, sin) of D_0026185C*omega

name: GetCircleProgress
evidence: slot 3 of D_0021E3F8: returns the angle D_0026185C*omega wrapped to 2 pi, over 2 pi

name: LoadTriangleAnimator
evidence: slot 0 of D_0021E418: reads a corner and two edges from the block and sets cursor flag bit 1 (coordinates)

name: GetTriangleOutputs
evidence: slot 6 of D_0021E418: stores the addresses of the animator's three output floats into the caller's array
